pages.title: Why Does AeroIE Exist?
pages.text: Since Create: Aeronautics and its Sable engine were released, players have built countless clever structures and vehicles. However, individual components still offer limited integration and data exchange, while vanilla redstone constrains truly centralized, unified, high-performance vehicle control. AeroIE provides simple solutions for functions such as piloting and weapons, together with visual effects and models suited to a wider range of vehicle designs.

pages.title: Behind the Project
pages.text: In October 2025, KODU16 wanted to build a Cosmic Horizon space-combat modpack. Existing Valkyrien Skies addons either crashed during Cosmic's frequent dimension changes or added the exciting surprise of systems failing at random while crossing the universe. None met the requirements of a true interstellar vehicle system, so an annoyed KODU16 started learning Java and created the early project, vsie, which later evolved into AeroIE.
